scope: Generic official DQC 0015 CSV concept registries, not filing data or expected answers. Prefix-only names default to 2026; namespace URIs or an explicit taxonomy_year select a released registry. US GAAP: exact 2015-2026 tables; SRT: exact 2023-2026 plus official legacy CSV for earlier taxonomies; EBP: exact 2024-2026; DEI: generic official CSV. Dimensional exclusions remain the pinned workbook plus 2026 Xule explicit additions; this is not a historical rule-release or form-applicability engine. Registries are encoded as differences from the default concept_rule_ids. CSV tokens already containing a namespace prefix are preserved; a prefix is attached only to bare local names. All 21 reconstructed registries were verified exactly against pinned source CSV bytes, suffix IDs, key uniqueness and per-table counts. The US GAAP 2015-2018 CSVs include 14 invest-prefixed concepts each; these exact source names are retained in their historical tables, while the runtime does not infer unsupported invest namespace URI aliases.
